scope: Local built application; production verification is recorded separately after deployment.

video_file.source_media: Private validation clip, kept outside the repository; only aggregate results are recorded.

camera.capture_source: Browser-generated MediaStream fixtures; one private face clip and one mathematical moving rectangle. getUserMedia was replaced for testing. No physical camera or microphone was accessed.

responsive_layout.method: Same-origin iframe containing the actual application

limitations: Physical Android hardware and camera drivers were not tested.
Live preview frame rate depends on device and model execution speed.
These tests establish media plumbing and effect application, not exact native temporal tracking parity.
